event_name: Time 19:00 2020 PORTUGUESE GRAND PRIX 22 to 25 October Due to a personal bereavement, the driver steward, Vitaly Petrov has had to withdraw from the Event. Under the authority of the Stewards under Art 11.9.3.n of the International Sporting Code, the Stewards amend Appendix 1, Part B of the Formula One Sporting Regulations for this Event and nominate Mr. Bruno Correia to replace Mr. Petrov.
title: Stewards Substitution
